_readme: Runners for bin/dispatch. One entry per seat. `command` is ONE line of shell, run as `bash -c`
with the prompt on stdin and in $DISPATCH_PROMPT_FILE; non-interactive only, there is no tty.
Copy this file, point $DISPATCH_RUNNERS at the copy, swap the placeholders for CLIs you have.
timeout_sec = wall-clock kill, budget_bytes = output cap; unset fields fall back to `defaults`.

stub.description: No model at all: echoes the prompt back. Proves file, sentinel, deadline, digest with nothing installed.

cli.description: Any agent CLI in print mode. Replace the placeholder, e.g. `your-agent-cli -p "$(cat "$DISPATCH_PROMPT_FILE")"`.

local.description: A local model through ollama, prompt on stdin. Swap the model tag for one you have pulled.
